question: Prashant and Nisha have to travel from Delhi to Kanpur in their respective cars. Prashant is driving at 72 km/hr while Nisha is driving at 64 km/hr. Find the time taken by Nisha to reach Kanpur if Prashant takes 16 hours.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Speed ratio of Prashant and Nisha = 72 : 64 = 9 : 8

Since the distance is constant, the time ratio is inversely proportional to the speed ratio = 8 : 9

Prashant's time = 8 units = 16 hours

Nisha's time = 9 units = (16 ÷ 8) × 9 = 18 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 18 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of Prashant = 72 km/hr

Time taken by Prashant = 16 hours

Speed of Nisha = 64 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

 
• 
 
 
 Delhi
 Kanpur
 
 Prashant: 72 km/hr | 16 hours
 
 Nisha: 64 km/hr | T hours
 Distance = Constant

**Calculations:**

⇒ Distance travelled by Prashant = 72 × 16

⇒ Distance = 1152 km

⇒ Since Nisha travels the same distance, her time = Total Distance ÷ Nisha's Speed

⇒ Time taken by Nisha = 1152 ÷ 64

⇒ Time taken by Nisha = 18 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 18 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed

When two bodies move in the same direction, relative speed = S₁ − S₂. When moving in opposite directions, relative speed = S₁ + S₂.

Average Speed

For different distances travelled at different speeds, Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time.

Unit Conversion

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply the speed by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply the speed by 18/5.
